The '''Manaan Mini-Sub''' was a model of [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] that was used on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] around the time of [[Third Galactic War]]. The [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Arn Peralun]] used such vehicle during the [[Invasion of Manaan]] to access the [[Imperial Kolto Mining Facility]].<ref name="TOR:BP" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Manaan_Mini-Sub.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The player speeder version of the submersible.]]
The Manaan Mini-Sub first appeared in the main storyline quests of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="TOR:BP" /> It was later added to the game as a player mount via the [[Cartel Market]]. Although it was a submersible, this mount was used by players as a regular landspeeder mount.<ref name="TOR:MMS" />
